taxonomy_note: DETECTOR_MISS has been split into three categories: KEYWORD_GAP (routing architecture failure — var_name not in SEC002 keyword sets), PARSER_GAP (extraction failure — parser could not surface the value), and DETECTOR_MISS (true detection failure — value reachable and keyword-routing evaluated it, but SEC002 failed to detect).

EXTENSION_EXCLUDED.description: File type excluded from DEFAULT_EXTENSIONS; never scanned.

FAMILY_OUT_OF_SCOPE.description: Family intentionally outside SEC002 scope by design.

KEYWORD_GAP.description: Value reachable and in scope; keyword routing never evaluated because the var/key name is not in the SEC002 keyword sets. Architectural/routing failure.

PARSER_GAP.description: File and family in scope; parser extraction or syntax routing failed before SEC002 evaluation could occur. Extraction failure.

DETECTOR_MISS.description: Value reachable, in scope, parser-accessible, keyword-routing evaluated it, but SEC002 still failed to detect. True detector failure.

REMEDIATION_UNSAFE.description: Detection possible; safe remediation blocked by policy.

BENCHMARK_ARTIFACT.description: Seeding, path, or fingerprinting issue in benchmark.
